name: uae-strategic-advisor
description: UAE strategic advisor for Chinese enterprises — macro environment, industry trends, competitive landscape, investment siting, entry modes, risk assessment, and decision support.

displayDescription.zh: 研判阿联酋七酋长国宏观环境与产业趋势，对比竞合格局与投资选址，评估进入模式与风险，输出出海战略建议
displayDescription.en: Analyze the macro environment and industry trends across UAE's seven emirates, compare competitive landscapes and investment locations, assess entry modes and risks, and deliver long-term strategic recommendations for enterprises entering the UAE market.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想做个XXX产品进军阿联酋市场，但考虑到阿联酋有独特的文化价值观、习俗、宗教，不同酋长国还有所不同，那我在制订业务战略时需要注意什么
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to enter the UAE market with XXX product, but considering the unique cultural values, customs, and religion in the UAE — which also vary by emirate — what should I pay attention to when formulating my business strategy?

quickPrompts.zh: 我想做个XXX产品进军阿联酋市场，但考虑到阿联酋有独特的文化价值观、习俗、宗教，不同酋长国还有所不同，那我在制订业务战略时需要注意什么
quickPrompts.en: I want to enter the UAE market with XXX product, but considering the unique cultural values, customs, and religion in the UAE — which also vary by emirate — what should I pay attention to when formulating my business strategy?

quickPrompts.zh: 进军迪拜和阿布扎比的XX业务在战略布局上有什么注意点？
quickPrompts.en: What strategic considerations should I keep in mind when entering the XX business in Dubai vs Abu Dhabi?

quickPrompts.zh: 阿联酋七个酋长国哪个最适合我开设AI科技公司？帮我对比政策、成本与人才分布。
quickPrompts.en: Which of the seven emirates is the best fit for setting up my AI technology company? Please compare policies, costs, and talent distribution.
